lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Commander

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: I want to buy a leash.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: What about a black leather one?
Did you say... a leash?

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: A leash.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: what kind of blindfold do you prefer?

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Would a leather one put you off?

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: This one also looks quite nice, such lovely white fabric...
Can you just slow down for a second?

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Yan told me about a new shopping mall that I'd enjoy,

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: so I went there today to have a look.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: It's like I've died and gone to heaven!

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Yuni and I are on a shopping spree.
But why are you asking me these questions?

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: we've already bought more than enough for ourselves.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: So we thought we should pick out something for you.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Mihara and I talked it over,

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: but we still don't know what you're into.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: So we figured we'd ask you a few questions.
No, please. Don't.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Oooh oooh, Commander!

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: There's something here called a Sticky Whip.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: It clings slightly to whatever spot you use it on.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Apparently, it is an experience unlike any other.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: What do you think?
Awesome.
Meh.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: I knew you'd love it!

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Hmm, maybe we need to turn it up a notch.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: This electric whip could do the trick.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Commander, when are you going to come over?

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: We have so much to discuss, and the whip could join us...

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: I've prepared plenty of other toys as well.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Do you have time today?
Sorry, I'm busy today.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: How about tomorrow?
I'm busy tomorrow as well.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Seems like you've got a lot on your plate.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: I guess I'll have to try it on Mihara first.

lines.speaker: yuni
lines.text: Don't forget to contact us when you have time.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: If we don't reply to your messages straight away,

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: it's because we're... preoccupied.

lines.speaker: mihara
lines.text: Have a nice day, Commander!
